thresholds.note: geom_tau = median over correct frames of |det_c - pred_c| / gate_radius; app_tau = median over correct frames of the appearance cost of the selected candidate. The |log h| leg is the plan's fixed 0.25, and the correct-frame median is reported only to show it sits inside that bound.

channel_off.label: reference: both E077 arms off (shipped behaviour)

channel_fusion.label: arm B: channel-conditional acceptance (OR-branch on the bound)
channel_fusion.mechanism: geometry OR appearance may carry acceptance

channel_aspect.label: arm C: bounded-aspect coasting
channel_aspect.mechanism: coasted aspect clamped to the last observed band

ship_rule: pooled dTSR >= +3 pp AND paired-dTSR 95%% CI excludes 0 AND paired-dFAR CI upper < +3 pp AND blind-AND-present share falls; KILL on bit-identity or dTSR < 0
